purpose: Mandatory chapter-transition recruitment / branch party-select screen: player picks the party for the next battle on a 10x3 grid, then per-chapter required-char gates are enforced and a final 'ready to fight?' confirm is shown; returns 1 only when a full party was committed, every required-char gate passed, and confirm was YES.
logic_summary: max_chars = current_chapter_id>0x1A ? 0x13 : 0x0F. Clear selection_state[0..29]. Alloc 4x 64000-byte mode-13h buffers (anim accumulator, bg snapshot, panel_buf local, composed target); snapshot VGA 0xA0000 -> bg -> panel_buf; blit panel layers (atlas +0x56 header -> +0x91C, atlas +0x5A grid frame -> +0x7585, sprite 0x89 -> +0x8C5); initial render; 12-frame slide-in (SFX 5 at iter 0xB and 5). Input loop do/while(result_flag==0): wait_input_with_recruitment_repaint returns scancode (full EAX); independent if-tests (not a switch); 0x01 ESC -> result_flag=-1; 0x1C Enter -> SFX 7, toggle selection_state[cursor], scancode:=0x4D, if count_selected==max_chars -> result_flag=1 + reorder_party_by_selection; 0x4B Left -> SFX 0, cursor-- (underflow wraps to count-2); 0x4D Right -> SFX 0, cursor++ (at count-1 -> cursor^=(count-1) i.e. 0); 0x48 Up (cursor>9) -> SFX 0, cursor-=10; 0x50 Down (cursor<count-11) -> SFX 0, cursor+=10; re-render then blit composed target -> 0xA0000. 12-frame slide-out (SFX 6 at iter 0 and 7); restore VGA from bg snapshot; free all 4 buffers. If result_flag==1: free portrait cache, reopen FDICON.B24, reset cache count, reload all party portraits, fclose; resolve required char_id by current_chapter_id and call require_char_id_in_active_party(max_chars,id) storing 0/1 into result_flag (chapter 0x10+has(0x12)->0x12; 0x11/0x13/>=0x1A->9; 0x12->0x10; 0x14->0x15; 0x15/0x16->0x18; 0x19+has(9)->0x1D; others no gate). Gate at LAB_31CD4 collapses every non-1 result_flag to 0 and returns 0. For result_flag==1: re-resolve same chapter table (0x19 pins char 9 first), pin_required_char_to_party_slot1(id); load_chapter_portrait(0x4B); display 'ready to fight?' dialog (FDTXT 0x292) + paint portrait; battle_tile_map guard=1; clear keyboard; typewriter loop; guard=0; page-advance collapse; slide dialog out. Return 1 iff typewriter_ret != -1 AND cursor_idx==0 (YES row), else 0.

returns.semantics: 1 = a full party was committed AND every required-char gate passed AND the final confirm was YES; 0 = ESC / declined / failed required-char gate / NO at confirm. Both callers TEST EAX / JZ <loop>: 0 re-runs the mandatory screen, 1 proceeds. (ESC sets internal result_flag=-1 inside the input loop, but the post-commit gate at LAB_31CD4 collapses every non-1 value to 0.)
